jurisdiction.basis: NLA/RSDI publishes the Kigali-specific LAIS cadastral parcel layer. Receipt probes establish substantial-city discovery coverage, not exhaustive coverage.

followUps: Native layer CRS is ITRF_2005 Transverse Mercator WKT without an advertised EPSG/WKID. outSR=4326 is provider transformed; native datum, operation, grids and wire-axis proof are unverified. No fitted offset is used.

Prior unchanged 54-parcel WUP sample has a 6.960046758807686 m² material overlap between UPI 1/02/08/01/1169 and 1/02/08/01/783. Both are deliberately included in this exact-read qualification. See evidence/prior-metric-report.json.
Current/historical validity semantics and temporal lineage are unverified; no temporal filtering or duplicate suppression.
Citywide completeness, district-boundary coverage, exhaustive paging and binding require second-pass review. Initial exact reads and any 13 bounded cells cannot prove citywide coverage.
Explicit reuse/redistribution terms require confirmation before any reuse decision.
